scope: One exact algebraic bridge criterion for October torus force projection versus Lean zero-pressure/solenoidal-force construction; no certification.
assumptions: W is a smooth, spatially periodic, divergence-free vector field on flat T_L^3 with zero spatial mean.
alpha is a smooth scalar function of time, independent of x.
nu is the fixed viscosity; A(W)=(W·grad)W; Delta acts spatially.
The torus Poisson potential is normalized to spatial mean zero.
paper_force: U_alpha=alpha(t) W(x); g_alpha=alpha'(t) W+alpha(t)^2 A(W)-nu alpha(t) Delta W.

proved_algebra.reason: div W=0, div Delta W=Delta div W=0; time coefficients are spatial constants.

proved_algebra.identity: phi_alpha(t,x)=alpha(t)^2 phi_W(x), with Delta phi_W=div A(W), mean(phi_W)=0
proved_algebra.reason: Uniqueness of mean-zero torus Poisson solution and step 1.

proved_algebra.identity: Q g_alpha=alpha(t)^2 grad phi_W; P g_alpha=alpha' W+alpha^2 [A(W)-grad phi_W]-nu alpha Delta W
p_projected(t,x)=-alpha(t)^2 phi_W(x) when the unprojected pressure is zero

proved_algebra.reason: Differentiate div[(W·grad)W] and use div W=0.

necessary_and_sufficient: At any t with alpha(t) != 0, P g_alpha(t)=g_alpha(t) iff div A(W)=0 everywhere, equivalently phi_W=0. This is a criterion for unprojected-force equality, not a statement that the paper's W satisfies or violates it.

lean_comparison.actual: SlowFluidProperties requires Solenoidal(force nu U), IsClassicalSolution ... (fun _ => 0), and uniqueness with pressure zero; slow_initialized_bundle uses initializedProgram_zero_advection to construct that bundle.
lean_comparison.difference: ZeroAdvection V is stronger than merely div A(V)=0. The October manuscript allows general autonomous W and explicitly projects the force, with pressure -phi. A direct identity of the unprojected forces or zero-pressure bundles requires the above criterion and an independent velocity/coordinate identification.
not_established: Whether the specific manuscript W has div A(W)=0.
Any identification of W with initializedProgram or slowFromRest's log-time V.
An exact Lean theorem for the paper's general projection operator and quantitative H^(r+2) to C^r estimate.

independent_sanity_example.A_W: (sin x cos y, sin y cos x, 0)
independent_sanity_example.interpretation: Even divergence-free, mean-zero W can produce a non-solenoidal raw residual; projection can change the force and pressure. This is a toy field, not the manuscript's W.

review_target: Compute div[(W·grad)W] for the October autonomous W on its source chart and collar, then check whether the resulting phi_W vanishes. If nonzero, retain projected pressure as a distinct mathematical object; map the projection theorem and norm estimates separately to Lean.
claim_boundary: Elementary analytic derivation with pinned source definitions; no full Lean replay, manuscript proof validation, or MATHCERT certification.
